title: I should've read the reviews first, but
text:
I should've read the reviews first, but. ....but I thought, "how can anyone mess up a simple taco press"? Well, it certainly has some issues.
Luckily, I anticipated that I would need a deep pot of oil. I had just enough oil so that I did not need to flip the press over or actually take the hot taco out and turn it. I was able to just drop it in and take my hand away because the bent handle held it in place. There were a few times that I tried to flip the press, only to realize that wasn't really an option. I didn't really need to. The oil was deep enough that the grease bubble cooked the top portion. Next time I'll use a deeper pot because the oil did splash out more than I was comfortable with.
The first two tacos that I did came out in a wide V shape that made them impossible to bite. I was pretty irritated with that, but my husband just squeezed them together to make it a better shape. The first taco I put in tore because of the new, tighter shape, so I put the rest in the microwave to warm them/make them more pliable.
After that, they all cooked pretty well but they did swell up so that the outside was crunchy and the inside was a little soft. Next time I'll make sure the oil isn't so hot so that maybe the whole thing will be crunchy.
It was really more of a pain than it was worth for the first use, but hopefully it won't fall apart and I can keep using it for awhile.
I wouldn't buy another one if I found a better product. I'd gladly spend more for something better.

description: Measures: 13" x 2.5" x 3.5" / 33 cm x 6cm x 9cm Fresh tacos shells are so much better tasting than store bought!
The process of making tacos at home just got so much easier, with this uniquely designed taco press!

Use to mold tortillas into fresh, crisp, fried taco shells! Faster, safer and easier than the old fork and tong method. Simple and easy to use! Perfect tacos every time! The L-shaped handle rests on the fryer rim to protect your hands from hot oil. Made of chromed steel, with stay-cool rubberized plastic handle grips. Great for use with corn or flour tortillas! Mold measures 4-1/4 inch in diameter.

Norpro was founded in 1973 with a vision to design, manufacture, and supply the highest caliber kitchenware. Norpro’s offering of innovative, high quality product for cooking, preparing and serving food are produced with superior materials and craftsmanship.

This is the essential tool for molding tortillas into crisp, fried taco shells. Simply place a small tortilla into the mold (it measures 4-1/2 inches in diameter) and squeeze the handle to press the tortilla into a

shape. Plunge the press into hot oil, and the tortilla fries into a crisp taco shell suitable for filling with ground meat or picadillo, grated cheese, lettuce, and salsa. The stainless-steel press measures 13 inches overall, and the handle forms an
shape so it can rest on the fryer's rim and protect your hand from hot, splattering oil. Rubberized plastic covers the handle grips so they stay cool. The press is dishwasher-safe.
